thread:
jamie: Heads-up — putting the EU rollout (v1.9.3) on hold. Observability shows node instability in eu-west-1 affecting inference hosts. Deploybot just paused the canary. Anyone oncall?

deploy-bot: Automated: canary paused by policy. commit=abc1234f, reason=region-eu-host-ooms. Actions: hold, pin, notify.

sasha: ops-oncall — can you confirm scope? Is this infra-only (kernel/AMI) or something application-level?

ops-oncall: Investigating now. Initial signal: host-level OOMs on GPU pool serving kv-cache after the recent kernel test. Not seeing app-level errors yet. Will post root-cause update in ~5m.

liam: We should avoid moving any model or config changes into EU until cleared. Suggest pinning EU traffic to v1.9.2 and routing new canaries to us-west only.

maria: Product ok with holding. I'll prep customer-facing note and release notes update.

jamie: Proposed short plan: 1) keep hold for EU, 2) cancel EU stagger waves, 3) run a minimal smoke canary in us-west only, 4) reschedule EU windows for tomorrow 03:00 UTC if stable. Agree?

sasha: +1. Also add rollback options: revert kernel patch or drain and reprovision the affected pool.

ops-oncall: Plan A: revert kernel patch tonight -> expected recovery 30–45m. Plan B if unstable: roll to previous AMI and disable the optimization. We'll tag affected hosts as `quarantine` to prevent new deploys.

deploy-bot: Command: `/deploy pause --scope=eu --pin=release:v1.9.2 --reason="incident-eu-oom"` (automated action recorded). Canary schedule for EU cleared. Notifying ops and product.

jamie: I'll update #incidents and the ops status page. Maria — can you draft the short customer blurb? Keep it calm and non-technical.

maria: Draft posted to #incidents-drafts: "We're delaying the EU release due to infrastructure instability affecting inference hosts. No customer data exposure. We're working on a fix and will update the status page with a reschedule time."

liam: For engineers: freeze infra merges to main until ops says otherwise. If you have an urgent patch, DM me directly.

sasha: Add a 'rollback-readiness' checklist to the release PR (owners, commands, verification steps). Prevents surprises during an emergency rollback.

jamie: Will add checklist to PR now — ETA 10m.

ops-oncall: 10m status: revert started on 8 hosts, OOM occurrences dropping in metrics. Holding until 60 minutes of stable metrics before we talk reschedule.

maria: Customer note posted to status.redwood.ai: "EU release delayed — investigating infrastructure instability."

jamie: Thanks team. Reconvene in 30m (or sooner if ops updates). :hourglass_flowing_sand:
